Your margin drops a little, from 35.8% to 35.4%. That's a fall of 0.4 points. I ran this as a what-if, so nothing was saved.

**What changes**
- Seven products from Rexel Darwin cost 10% more.
- Average cost per item goes from $336.71 to $338.39, up 0.5%.
- Stock held at cost goes from $67,775.75 to $68,606.62. That's $830.88 more, up 1.2%.

**The seven products (cost before, then after)**
- Clipsal Switchboard: $245.00 to $269.50
- Meter Enclosure: $110.00 to $121.00
- LED Batten 1200mm: $38.00 to $41.80
- Hager RCBO: $28.00 to $30.80
- Weatherproof GPO: $24.00 to $26.40
- Earth Rod: $18.00 to $19.80
- Conduit 25mm: $7.25 to $7.97

- TES-102 (Daniel Wilson, Crew B) needs the Weatherproof GPO.
- TES-104 (Red Plains Cattle Station, Crew C) needs the Earth Rod.
- TES-105 (Aisha Brown) needs the LED Batten.

**Two gaps in the numbers**
- Cable Tie Pack is also a Rexel Darwin item, but it has no cost on file. The model left it out, so the real hit is a bit bigger. Please confirm its cost.
- This only covers stock cost. It doesn't change what you charge on jobs. If you pass the rise on, margin holds.
